verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents cutting a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and sharing just that segment. The closest items are adjacent: organizing meetings to 'revisit key highlights' (otter-docs-12), shareable transcript text, and channel-level sharing of whole recordings. None of these describe clipping or sharing a single moment.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
